dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So, which laptop do you like, the black one or the silver one?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈwɪtʃ ˈlæptɑːp duː juː ˈlaɪk, ðə ˈblæk wʌn ɔːr ðə ˈsɪlvər wʌn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The silver one is less expensive than the black one, right?
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈsɪlvər wʌn ɪz ˈlɛs ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ðən ðə ˈblæk wʌn, ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. It's more affordable, and it's lightweight.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ˈmɔːr əˈfɔːrdəbəl, ənd ɪts ˈlaɪtweɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A little. But it has better battery life. About fifteen hours.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ɪt ˈhæz ˈbɛtər ˈbætəri ˌlaɪf. əˈbaʊt ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's important for me. I study in the library all day.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ɪmˈpɔːrtənt fər miː. aɪ ˈstʌdi ɪn ðə ˈlaɪbrɛri ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Then the black one is the least practical for you. It's heavy.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ðə ˈblæk wʌn ɪz ðə ˈliːst ˈpræktɪkəl fər juː. ɪts ˈhɛvi.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Can I get an upgrade later?
dialogue.reading: kən aɪ ˈɡɛt ən ˈʌpɡreɪd ˈleɪtər?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. It's our least expensive model, but it's a great laptop.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. ɪts aʊr ˈliːst ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ˈmɑːdəl, bʌt ɪts ə ˈɡreɪt ˈlæptɑːp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK, I've decided. I'll take the silver one!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ, aɪv dɪˈsaɪdɪd. aɪl ˈteɪk ðə ˈsɪlvər wʌn!
